commands.name: CreateStandaloneDispatchLocation
steps: validate bounded name/address and compute key
inside UnitOfWork allocate location/lifecycle IDs, insert receipt, insert active standalone location, append created lifecycle event, audit, commit
rules: operation role not stored on master

commands.name: CreateDedicatedDispatchLocationForSite
commands.visibility: internal cross-domain service used by LLD-08 coordinator
steps: verify precomputed key belongs to exact supplied name and active matching profile
insert site_derived location with null standalone address
append created lifecycle event referencing shared receipt
return identity/event to LLD-08 coordinator for Site relation + final audit before shared commit
commands.rule: failure of Site/relation/audit rolls back Dispatch Location/lifecycle/receipt in same UnitOfWork

commands.name: UpdateReferenceDescriptiveData
steps: inside UnitOfWork load active target/revalidate revision
if all governed stored fields/derived keys equal request apply SemanticNoChange
otherwise insert receipt, update allowed fields/increment revision, append descriptive_corrected lifecycle event, audit bounded prior/new evidence, commit
rules: site_derived address cannot be overwritten here

commands.name: WriteSetting
commands.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork after strict JSON + state-independent preflight
steps: outside write transaction resolve closed SettingDefinition and strict JSON/state-independent validation
inside UnitOfWork revalidate persisted revision/absence and run bounded state-dependent owner checks
if same contract/version and SettingDefinition.semantic_equals(current,requested) apply SemanticNoChange
otherwise insert receipt, INSERT or explicit UPDATE setting with next revision, audit, commit
rules: secret-classified settings rejected from this store

commands.name: CreateLocalUserProfileIdentity
input: existing UnitOfWork from LLD-12 setup coordinator
commands.rule: LLD-12 owns verifier/auto-login and commits metadata+authentication state atomically or rolls all back
